content: {"praised":["Christopher Meloni delivers strong performance as Mark Fuhrman.","The film offers a gripping, creative perspective on the Moxley case.","The mystery keeps viewers hooked until the end.","The story complements the book and deepens intrigue.","The movie presents a unique, thoughtful take on justice."],"criticized":["The plot is too simple and idealized.","The pacing is slow, causing boredom.","The film lacks creativity and drama.","It feels like a straightforward retelling with little flair.","The movie focuses too much on praising Fuhrman."]}
